news.detail: Szmyt made field goals from 45 yards and 48 yards during the contest, with the 45-yarder coming in the fourth quarter to stake the Browns to a 13-12 lead. The kicker moved to a perfect 6-of-6 on field goals and 4-of-4 on PATs through three regular-season games in 2026.
